title: Craft Your First HTML Page
description: Create a valid HTML document with a personalised title and a greeting.
problemStatement:
Your mission: write a complete HTML page from scratch.

**Requirements:**
- The file must start with `<!DOCTYPE html>`.
- Include `<html>`, `<head>`, and `<body>` tags.
- Set the page title (shown in the browser tab) to **"My Progly Journey"**.
- Inside the body, add an `<h1>` that says **"Hello, World!"**.
- Below the heading, add a paragraph that says **"I am learning to code with Progly."**

Save the file as `journey.html` and test it in your browser.
hints: Remember: all visible content goes inside `<body>`.
expectedOutput: When opened in a browser, the page should display a heading "Hello, World!" and a paragraph below it, with the tab reading "My Progly Journey".
solutionCode:
Hello, World!

I am learning to code with Progly.
